mapper.sql: id, block_key AS blockKey, block_name AS blockName, block_type AS blockType, content, item_count AS itemCount, cache_seconds AS cacheSeconds, status, sort, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
id, block_id AS blockId, title, image, url, summary, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, status, sort, create_time AS createTime
mapper.insert: insert into fly_block (id, block_key, block_name, block_type, content, item_count, cache_seconds, status, sort, create_time) values (#{id}, #{blockKey}, #{blockName}, #{blockType}, #{content}, #{itemCount}, #{cacheSeconds}, #{status}, #{sort}, now())
mapper.select: select from fly_block where block_key = #{key} limit 1
select count(*) > 0 from fly_block where block_key = #{key}
select from fly_block order by sort asc, id desc limit #{offset}, #{rows}
mapper.insert: insert into fly_block_item (id, block_id, title, image, url, summary, start_time, end_time, status, sort, create_time) values (#{id}, #{blockId}, #{title}, #{image}, #{url}, #{summary}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{sort}, now())
